choices.reason: The native switch state supports the shortcut motif. I prefer seed 29's wider horizontal loop and shorter direct return because the spatial contrast is more legible; this is a qualitative layout preference, not a measured fun result.

The native preview state supports the visible-before-access motif. I prefer seed 11's tighter footprint for a concise preview-to-access traversal; this is a qualitative spatial preference, not a measured fun result.

The native recovery state supports the spent-key recovery motif. I prefer seed 11's tighter loop because the repeated recovery traversal is shorter; this is a qualitative play-space preference, not a measured fun result.
